title: BUGFIX — dashboard crashes on sprint list (sprint-1362.json malformed JSON)
rationale: dashboard/parsers/sprints.py list_sprints() crashes with KeyError: 'number' because sprint-1362.json has unescaped double quotes in its rationale field ({"detail":"Not Found"}), causing parse_sprint() to return the minimal error dict that lacks 'number'. Fix both: repair sprint-1362.json and make parse_sprint() error path include all required keys.

tasks.description: Fix unescaped double quotes in sprint-1362.json rationale field.
In dashboard/parsers/sprints.py parse_sprint() error path, add all required keys (number, title, phase, etc.) so list_sprints() never throws KeyError on a bad file.
